summary: Code review verification of DrawGame and FeudGame camera/canvas overlap bug fix. Both games implement proper separation between camera sections and game UI content. DrawGame uses border-b border-white/5 pb-2 to separate camera grid from canvas. FeudGame uses border-b border-white/5 to separate camera cards from answers area. Camera heights have been reduced (DrawGame: 16/7.4 aspect ratio in compact mode, FeudGame: h-[4.5rem] mobile, h-[4.75rem] sm, h-[5rem] lg). Live two-player testing not possible in single-session environment.
critical_code_review_comments: DrawGame.jsx line 753: PlayerVideoGrid wrapper has 'border-b border-white/5 pb-2' - creates visual separation from canvas below
DrawGame.jsx line 413: Camera aspect ratio is '16/7.4' (compact mode) - reduced from previous values to make cameras shorter
DrawGame.jsx line 808: Canvas area is in separate div below camera section with min-h-[280px] sm:min-h-[320px]
FeudGame.jsx line 283: Camera section has 'border-b border-white/5' - creates visual separation from content below
FeudGame.jsx line 287: Camera heights reduced to h-[4.5rem] (mobile), h-[4.75rem] (sm), h-[5rem] (lg)
FeudGame.jsx line 394: Answers board uses flex-1 to take remaining space below camera section
Both games use flex-col layout ensuring camera section is always above game content
No absolute positioning that could cause overlap between camera and game UI
